Language proficiency 
requirement
If students want to take Korean lectures, Korean 
language proficiency score (TOPIK or equivalent) of 
level 3 or higher is preferred. 
If students will take only English lectures, no 
requirements.
We recommend that students have enough English 
skills to understand English lessons.

G.P.A Requirement N/A
Application Process 
&
Required Documents 
[27 Spring Intake]
“Letter of admission for applicants will be sent on 
the End of Dec.”
<Nomination required: Excel sheet> 20 November 
The nomination sheet will be distributed to the 
partner universities. *Attached Excel Sheet
<Application required: Google survey format)> 1 December
[Step1]
  https://forms.gle/tnxvZPTKKqJjamTP7
Required documents (should be uploaded to the 
Google form along with the answers to the survey) 
a. Certificate of Enrollment issued from Oct to 
Dec 2026 in English
b. Passport copy (must be valid until the end of 
the period of stay in Korea; end of 
January/end of July)
c. PHOTO (35㎜×45㎜) - A color photo taken 
within last 6 months(full face without hat, 
front view against white or off-white 
background)
d. Official transcripts in English
<After application-Additional Document Submission>
[Step 2]
 Should upload documents by 20 December
   https://forms.gle/oV4XP9rRp7aTF2Cw7
[Step 3]
 Should be arrived in our office by 15 January via post.
[Additional Document] *In English or In Korean
a. Bank Statement (4,000USD/one semester,  
8,600USD/one year) (original copy , this should 
be valid on a month prior to admission. 
Please issue this paper in December.)
b. The school's Certificate of Enrollment
   (Original copy with an official stam p, issued after 
October 2026)
  - Certification Requirement: All students 
must have their Certificate of Enrollment 
legalized either by the Korean 
Embassy/Consulate in their home country 
(Consular Confirmation) or via Apostille.
